messages.tip.action_button: 使用目前資料和參數值執行此動作。
messages.tip.angle: 最小 angular separation, in degrees, between accepted density maxima. Larger values keep fewer, more widely separated 主 poles; smaller values may retain nearby peaks from the same orientation 組.
messages.tip.bins: 將 KDE 密度網格層級設為每軸 2^N 個儲存格。較高值可顯示更精細的密度細節，但需要更多記憶體和運算。請使用能解析穩定密度極大的最低值。
messages.tip.classify_action: Assigns each point to the closest reviewed 主 pole within the JS cone threshold and writes the JS 純量欄位. The reviewed pole table, not the original automatic peaks, is used.
messages.tip.colour.dof: 選取旋轉自由度。原始雙角度旋轉模型使用 2；三自由度模型使用內在 Z-Y-X 歐拉旋轉。
messages.tip.colour.objective: 選取最佳化時要最小化的目標函數。此函數會控制旋轉後的極點方向在色彩參考系統中的懲罰或分布方式。
messages.tip.colour.subsample: Percentage of valid point 法向量 used during optimisation. Lower percentages reduce computation time; 100% uses all valid 法向量.
messages.tip.colour.iterations: 最大 number of differential-evolution generations. Higher values allow a more extensive search but increase computation time.
messages.tip.colour.population: 差分演化使用的族群乘數。值越大，每一世代評估的候選旋轉越多，搜尋量和運算時間也會增加。
messages.tip.colour.seed: 選用的整數隨機種子。輸入數值可重現抽樣和最佳化結果；留空則使用新的隨機種子。
messages.tip.colour.export_copy: Creates a new CloudCompare 點雲 coloured using the selected colour space and the selected pole space. The original 點雲 is not modified.
messages.tip.colour.show_density: 顯示最佳化旋轉所得到的相對極點密度分布。此操作不會重新執行最佳化。
messages.tip.colour.show_poles: Displays the point-法向量 poles after applying the optimised rotation, using the selected stereonet projection.
messages.tip.clouds: When 面片 are created, also creates one separate 點雲 for each 最終 叢集. Disable this for very large datasets if the additional clouds use too much memory.
messages.tip.cluster: Runs DBSCAN independently within each positive JS 組, estimates a 組-specific eps, removes components smaller than ppcluster, fits 平面 equations, and writes cl, A, B, C, D and sigma using the original global point indices.
messages.tip.colour.optimise: Starts the 法向量-colour optimisation with the parameters entered above and determines the rotation angles that minimise the selected objective function.
messages.tip.dbscanminpts: 最小 number of points inside the DBSCAN neighbourhood, including the point itself, required for a core point. The MATLAB method uses 4. Increasing this value requires denser neighbourhoods and may classify more points as noise.
messages.tip.clustering_method: 選擇空間叢集演算法。DBSCAN 使用 K、k_sigma 和 MinPts；HDBSCAN 使用 Min Samples 和 Cluster Selection。
messages.tip.hdbscan_min_samples: HDBSCAN 密度參數。在數學上不等同於 DBSCAN MinPts；scikit-learn 的 HDBSCAN 會將點本身計入。
messages.tip.cluster_selection: EOM 選擇持續性叢集；Leaf 從階層中選擇更細緻的叢集。
messages.tip.density_action: Calculates the KDE pole-density surface and extracts automatic 主 poles. Review and, if necessary, edit the resulting pole table before assigning JS 組.
messages.tip.editable_param: 可編輯參數。適用時請輸入數值；相關標籤會指出單位和參數效果。
messages.tip.facets: Creates one convex planar mesh for each valid 最終 叢集 using its stored global point indices and fitted 平面. Clustering must be completed first.
messages.tip.family_clouds: After clustering, creates one 點雲 for each positive JS 組. Each 點雲 contains that 組’s points and retains the JS, cl and 平面 純量欄位.
messages.tip.family_plot_action: Plots point 法向量 coloured by their current JS value and overlays the reviewed 主 poles. This is available only when JS corresponds to the current reviewed pole table.
messages.tip.fix: When selected, each 叢集 in a JS 組 uses the reviewed 組-pole 法向量 and derives only D from the 叢集 centroid. When cleared, each 叢集 法向量 is fitted locally using PCA/SVD.
messages.tip.jscone: 最大 angular difference, in degrees, between a point 法向量 and a reviewed 主 pole. The closest pole inside this cone defines JS; points outside all cones receive JS=0.
messages.tip.kneighbor: Neighbour order used to estimate eps separately for each JS 組. The MATLAB method uses K=4 and queries K+1 neighbours because the first result is the point itself. Larger K represents a broader local spacing scale.
messages.tip.ksigma: Multiplier in eps = mean(unique KNN distances) + k_sigma × sample standard deviation. The MATLAB method uses 2. Larger values increase eps and tend to join components across wider gaps; smaller values tend to split 叢集.
messages.tip.labels: 顯示方位、角度指引和赤平投影網標註。這些指引僅供視覺參考，不會影響計算。
messages.tip.maxpoles: 最大 number of automatic 主 poles retained from the density surface. It limits the candidate JS 組; the reviewed pole table remains authoritative and can be edited manually.
messages.tip.merge: Coplanarity threshold based on |Di-Dj|/(sigma_i+sigma_j). Larger values merge more same-組 叢集 into a common 平面; smaller values preserve more separate 平面. Set 0 to disable this merge.
messages.tip.minclustersize: 最小 component size after DBSCAN, corresponding to MATLAB ppcluster. Components with fewer points are rejected and assigned cl=0. This does not control whether a point is a DBSCAN core point.
messages.tip.plot_poles: Plots all valid point 法向量 as poles on the selected stereonet projection. This is a visual inspection step and does not modify the 點雲.
messages.tip.pole_add: Adds a new 主 pole from the 傾向 and 傾角 values. The table and density plot update immediately; 組 IDs are renumbered and existing JS and 叢集 results become outdated.
messages.tip.pole_apply: Applies the 傾向 and 傾角 values to the selected 主 pole. The reviewed table becomes the source of truth, so JS classification and clustering must then be recalculated.
messages.tip.pole_delete: Deletes the selected 主 pole, renumbers the remaining 組 and refreshes the plot. Existing JS and 叢集 results become outdated.
messages.tip.pole_down: Moves the selected pole one row down. Because table order defines J_1, J_2, etc., this changes 組 IDs and requires JS classification and clustering to be recalculated.
messages.tip.pole_move: Changes the 組 order. Because 組 IDs follow table order, changing the order requires JS classification and clustering to be recalculated.
messages.tip.pole_table: Authoritative reviewed list of 主 poles. JS classification, 組 plots, Fisher K and subsequent clustering use this exact order and orientation. Editing or reordering the table invalidates existing JS and 叢集 results.
messages.tip.pole_up: Moves the selected pole one row up. Because table order defines J_1, J_2, etc., this changes 組 IDs and requires JS classification and clustering to be recalculated.
messages.tip.poles.source: Choose whether pole plots, density and automatic peak detection use the original 法向量 or 法向量 transformed by the optimised rotation. Stored 主-pole orientations always remain in the original reference system.
messages.tip.projection: Selects the stereographic projection used for plots. 等角 preserves angular relationships; equal-area preserves area. This setting changes only the visual projection, not the original point 法向量 or 純量欄位.
messages.tip.refresh: Refreshes the selected CloudCompare entity and checks which workflow actions and 工具 commands have the data required to run.
messages.tip.seed: Optional integer used only with 隨機 叢集 ordering. The same seed reproduces the numbering; leave blank to generate a new random order for each run.
messages.tip.show_density: Displays the last computed density and current 主 poles without recalculating the KDE or detecting peaks.

messages.tip.export_hsv: Exports a new 點雲 coloured with the selected colour space and calculated in the selected pole space (原始 or 旋轉後).

messages.colour.error.lightness_range: 明度必須介於 0 和 100 之間。
messages.tip.colour.space: Select the cylindrical colour space used to convert the rotated 法向量 orientation into RGB colours for the 點雲.
messages.tip.colour.lightness: 設定所選色彩空間的明度參數（0 至 100）。較高值通常會產生較亮的色彩。
messages.tip.spectral_clustering: 開啟頻譜叢集工具（Jimenez-Rodriguez & Sitar，2006），將極點分組為不連續面組，並在赤平投影圖上顯示。
messages.tip.spectral.sigma: 極點之間親和度的尺度。較小值（0.10）會更嚴格地分隔各組，也可能將一組拆成兩組；較大值（0.15）會合併相近極點。論文建議使用 0.10-0.15；預設值為 0.12。如果一組被拆開，請增加此值；如果兩組合併，請降低此值。
messages.tip.spectral.k: 要尋找的不連續面組數。根據密度圖輸入預期數量（例如 3 或 4），也可留空以使用下方方法自動選擇。
messages.tip.spectral.method: 僅在 K 為空時使用。'eigengap' 選擇相鄰特徵值之間最大躍升所對應的 K（快速）。'silhouette' 會嘗試最大值以內的所有 K，並保留分隔效果最佳的分群（較慢，但通常對含雜訊資料更穩健）。
messages.tip.spectral.kmax: 自動選擇時考慮的最大組數（最少為 2）。典型岩質邊坡有 3 到 6 組；8 是安全的上限。
messages.tip.spectral.samples: 此方法會建立 N x N 矩陣，因此記憶體和時間會隨 N 的平方增加。如果極點數超過此值，會隨機抽取該數量的極點（均勻抽樣、不重複，並使用固定種子以確保結果可重現）來尋找各組，其餘極點會指派至最近的組質心。如果極點較少，則全部使用。通常 2000-4000 已足夠；較大的值會較慢且需要更多記憶體。
messages.tip.spectral.status: 上次執行摘要：組數 K、sigma、silhouette 分數（越接近 1 表示分組越清楚）、使用的極點數及極點空間。
messages.tip.spectral.table: 各組在原始空間中的平均方向：極點數量和百分比、平面的傾向/傾角，以及其極點的趨勢/俯伏角。
messages.tip.tools.colour_optimisation: 尋找極點空間的旋轉方式，以最佳化法線的色彩表示。
messages.tip.tools.normal_spacing: 根據叢集平面計算各不連續面族的法線間距。
messages.tip.tools.persistence: 根據叢集平面估算各不連續面族的持續性。
messages.tip.tools.report: 產生技術報告（HTML/Markdown），包含本次工作階段中所有分析的參數、方法、圖表和結果。
messages.report.title: 技術報告
messages.report.author: 作者
messages.report.outdated_hint: 僅包含與目前主要極點一致的結果。如果編輯極點或重新執行步驟 1，請重新執行後續步驟以納入結果。
messages.report.no_results: 目前沒有可供報告的結果。請先執行至少一項分析（色彩最佳化、步驟 1 等）。
messages.tip.spectral.space: 分析使用的極點空間。'原始空間' 使用測得的法線（赤平投影圖會顯示羅盤方位標籤）。'旋轉空間' 使用色彩最佳化旋轉後的極點（僅在執行最佳化後可用；赤平投影圖沒有標籤）。表格中的質心方向一律以原始空間表示。
messages.tip.spectral.legend: 顯示或隱藏赤平投影圖上的圖例；圖例可能會遮住部分資料。
messages.tip.spectral.legend_orient: 選取後，圖例也會列出每個質心的傾向/傾角（原始空間）。取消選取可縮短圖例，減少對圖表的遮擋。
messages.tip.spectral.calculate: 使用這些參數執行頻譜叢集，並在赤平投影圖上繪製結果。將游標移至圖表上即可讀取傾向和傾角。
messages.about.body:
Authors:
  Adrián Riquelme Guill
  Roberto Tomás Jover
  Antonio Abellán Fernández
  University of Alicante

Scientific references:
  Riquelme, A.J., Abellan, A., Tomas, R., & Jaboyedoff, M. (2014).
  A new approach for semi-automatic rock mass joints recognition
  from 3D point clouds. Computers & Geosciences, 68, 38-52.
  https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cageo.2014.03.014

  Riquelme, A.J., Abellan, A., & Tomas, R. (2015).
  Discontinuity spacing analysis in rock masses using 3D point clouds.
  Engineering Geology, 195, 185-195.
  https://doi.org/10.1016/j.enggeo.2015.06.009

  Riquelme, A., Tomas, R., Cano, M., Pastor, J.L., & Abellan, A. (2018).
  Automatic mapping of discontinuity persistence on rock masses using
  3D point clouds. Rock Mechanics and Rock Engineering, 51, 3005-3028.
  https://doi.org/10.1007/s00603-018-1519-9

  Riquelme, A., Tomas, R., Cano, M., Pastor, J.L., & Abellan, A. (2026).
  Orientation-based colour mapping and spherical density analysis for
  rock discontinuity detection in 3D point clouds of roadcut slopes.
  Journal of Rock Mechanics and Geotechnical Engineering.
  https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jrmge.2025.12.059

  Riquelme Guill, A. (2015).
  Uso de nubes de puntos 3D para identificación y caracterización de
  familias de discontinuidades planas en afloramientos rocosos y
  evaluación de la calidad geomecánica. Doctoral thesis, University of
  Alicante.
  https://rua.ua.es/entities/publication/78d254b9-1a7b-49b1-a35a-c0edbdeeb225

Based on:
  Adrian Riquelme's MATLAB implementation of the Discontinuity Set
  Extractor (DSE), Department of Civil Engineering, University of
  Alicante, Spain.

Libraries and algorithms:
  - NumPy: numerical arrays and vector operations.
  - SciPy: KDE, differential evolution, nearest-neighbour queries,
    connected components and convex-hull geometry.
  - Matplotlib: stereonet, density and analysis plotting.
  - colorcet: scientific and perceptually useful colour maps used by
    the 叢集 visualisation.
  - Pillow: icon loading, resizing and GUI icon normalisation.
  - CloudCompare / pycc: point-點雲, 法向量 and scalar-field access.
  - Tkinter / ttk: graphical user interface.
  - PyVista (optional): interactive 3D 法向量/sphere visualisation.

  Algorithms and methods:
  - DSE 主-pole extraction using spherical/steronet KDE, based on
    the Botev et al. kernel-density approach.
  - Differential Evolution for 法向量-colour rotation optimisation.
  - DBSCAN (Ester et al., 1996) for spatial clustering of discontinuity
    組.
  - Fisher directional statistics for mean-pole concentration and
    confidence intervals.
  - cKDTree nearest-neighbour searches and Qhull convex-hull geometry
    through SciPy.

Acknowledgments:
  CloudCompare development team and the researchers whose methods
  underpin the DSE workflow.
